column3: Logo for a kids news program called "Little Big Questions". A small smiling planet Earth forms the dot of a big chunky question mark. Bold rounded wordmark "Little Big Questions" below, where "BIG" is extra large. Colors: sunny yellow, coral red, teal and deep navy. Flat vector, clean, centered on an off-white background, friendly cartoon style for a children's news show, soft rounded shapes, warm and hopeful, not scary
